# Phase Three — Final Execution Plan

## Final decision

Finish the current Internet-facing posting seam before redesigning Social Hub. Preserve public Archive.org storage evidence on each canonical media attachment through a generic optional `storage` object. Do not modify post-level `sourceProvenance`; it continues to describe imported post origin. Do not implement YouTube/Facebook/Instagram APIs in this pass.

## Canonical storage shape

The attachment may optionally contain:

- `provider`
- `externalId`
- `filename`
- `detailsUrl`
- `historyUrl`
- `fingerprint`
- `state`
- `uploadedAt`
- `verifiedAt`
- `etag`

No credential fields are accepted. `publicPath` remains the playback URL. `size` remains the canonical byte-size field.

## Files to create

### `social-composer/js/model/AttachmentStorage.js`
A tiny client mapper that converts a manifest's generic `storage` object or current Archive receipt fields into the bounded canonical storage descriptor. It also gives the post-payload layer one single responsibility for recognizing durable storage evidence.

### `api/social/helper/richSocial/AttachmentStorageSchema.js`
A tiny server sanitizer for optional storage descriptors. It will whitelist fields, bound text, accept only HTTPS evidence URLs, and return no private/unrecognized fields.

### `social-composer/js/model/test/AttachmentStorage.test.mjs`
A focused client witness: Archive receipt → canonical storage object; existing generic storage passes through; credentials/unknown matter are not emitted; Archive `bytes` is available for size mapping through the parent mapper contract.

### `api/social/helper/richSocial/test/attachmentStorage.test.js`
A focused server witness: storage fields normalize, unsafe URLs and unknown/private fields disappear, ordinary legacy attachments remain valid.

## Files to rewrite in full

### `social-composer/js/model/PostPayloadParts.js`
Preserve its existing exports and behavior. Import the new storage mapper. `attachmentPayload()` will:
- preserve the current canonical attachment fields,
- map `manifest.size || item.size || manifest.bytes || item.bytes` into `size`,
- include optional `storage` only when public storage evidence exists.

### `api/social/helper/richSocial/AttachmentSchema.js`
Preserve current exports/types/roles/normalization behavior. Delegate optional storage normalization to `AttachmentStorageSchema`. Keep legacy attachment compatibility and current size ceiling.

## Files explicitly protected in this pass

- `social-composer/js/model/PostPayload.js`
- `SourceProvenanceSchema.js`
- `RichPostOptions.js`
- `PublicationExecutor.js`
- `ContentPublisher.js`
- `socialContent.js`
- `social-hub/index.html`
- external-provider/OAuth code

They have no proven defect required by this seam.

## Thirty final checks and improvements

1. Full-file writes only.
2. Every source file starts with B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He.
3. Tabs for all source indentation.
4. No touched source file should exceed the repository's 120-line ideal.
5. Keep functions readable and multiline.
6. Keep public exports unchanged unless adding a strictly internal helper.
7. Do not move or rename existing modules.
8. Keep `publicPath` as renderer truth.
9. Keep `size` numeric and backward compatible.
10. Convert Archive `bytes` to canonical `size` without duplicating `bytes` in stored posts.
11. Keep storage optional.
12. Do not manufacture storage metadata for native uploads that do not provide it.
13. Map Archive `archiveIdentifier` → `storage.externalId`.
14. Map Archive `archiveFilename` → `storage.filename`.
15. Map Archive details/history links only as HTTPS URLs.
16. Map fingerprint/state/timestamps/etag as bounded text.
17. Do not carry `archiveDetailsUrl` et al as duplicate top-level attachment keys.
18. Drop IA-S3 access keys even if malicious input attempts to put them into `storage`.
19. Drop arbitrary extra storage properties.
20. Existing image/audio attachments must normalize exactly as before except optional absence of storage.
21. Existing clone-media paths must remain intact.
22. Existing root/section/subsection media mapping must use the same attachment contract.
23. Client tests run only after code is fully written and reread.
24. Server tests run only after code is fully written and reread.
25. Run current rich-social schema/service tests after focused storage tests.
26. Run current composer publication-truth tests after focused client tests.
27. Run syntax checks on every touched source/test file.
28. Trace one representative Archive asset through client payload and server normalization with actual executable evidence.
29. Inspect runtime/browser publication surface after unit/contract tests, without silently creating a surprise public test post.
30. Record planned-vs-actual delta and leave the next Social Hub/mobile/provider phase as explicit remaining work only after this gate is closed.

## Final file graph

`ArchiveOrgReceiptAsset` → `MediaUploader` → attachment manifest → `AttachmentStorage.js` → `PostPayloadParts.js` → unified publish API → `AttachmentStorageSchema.js` → `AttachmentSchema.js` → rich post → native post.

The Awtsmoos is one while the vessels are many; Awtsmoos.com must let durable public evidence cross each boundary cleanly, with no secret following behind. When this path is true, the next revelation can make the social surface swift on mobile and ready for many networks without confusing their identities.
